mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_business_document_seed (project_id, state, account_id, started_at, finished_at, failed_reason) values (#{projectId}, 'RUNNING', #{accountId}, now(), null, null) on conflict (project_id) do update set state = 'RUNNING', account_id = excluded.account_id, started_at = now(), finished_at = null, failed_reason = null where adk_builder_business_document_seed.state = 'FAILED'
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_business_document_seed set state = 'DONE', finished_at = now(), failed_reason = null where project_id = #{projectId} and state = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: select project_id as projectId, state, account_id as accountId, started_at as startedAt, finished_at as finishedAt, failed_reason as failedReason from builder.adk_builder_business_document_seed where project_id = #{projectId}

select project_id as projectId, state, account_id as accountId, started_at as startedAt, finished_at as finishedAt, failed_reason as failedReason from builder.adk_builder_business_document_seed where state = 'RUNNING'
